stemMarkdown: Which of the following sentences is grammatically correct?

options.markdown: The list of banned items is displayed at the entrance.
The list of banned items are displayed at the entrance.
The list of banned items were displayed at the entrance.
The list of banned items have been displayed at the entrance.

solutionMarkdown: The subject is **list**, which is singular; **of banned items** is a prepositional phrase and cannot change the subject. So the verb must be **is**. The plural noun sitting next to the verb is what misleads the ear.
